notes: Saved settings, one group per place they are kept. Browser: localStorage (stats_panel under cha.statsOverlay, toolbar per user and template). Native: config.json (stats_panel under overlay, toolbar per transport, host and app). A field has either a default or is optional (absent until picked). An invalid field falls back on its own: to its default, or to absent. int and number need a finite JSON number; an int that is not whole is invalid unless round is set; a value outside min..max is invalid unless clamp is set. A list keeps the entries that are among values, once each, in the order of values. An object is valid only when every one of its fields is.

stats_panel.doc: The stats panel: shown or hidden, folded, where it sits, how opaque.

compact.doc: The one-line view instead of the full one.

corner.doc: The corner it snaps to; the values run clockwise, the order the arrow keys walk.

folded.doc: Sections folded to their heading; the values are the full view's section ids, in the order shown.

snap.doc: On: it snaps to the nearest corner. Off: it stays where it is dropped (pos).

left.doc: Pixels (points natively) from the left of the video area.

top.doc: Pixels (points natively) from the top of the video area.

pos.doc: Where free placement left the panel's top left; null until it is moved.

toolbar.doc: What the toolbar last picked for an app. Never picked is not the same as picked, so every field is optional.

codec.doc: The codec asked for at launch (the native player takes it from its settings).

transport.doc: The browser's transport choice (natively the transport is part of the key).

mouse.doc: False: the mouse was switched off.

fps.doc: The frame rate asked for at launch.

overlay.doc: The Steam Gamescope overlay level; 4 is the full one.
